We're introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, so your work stays organized without rebuilding the same setup every time you open a project. Instead of manually adjusting filters each time you check overdue tasks, high-priority items, or a specific teammate's workload, you can now save that configuration once and return to it instantly.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans, and every user can create and save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to build custom perspectives for different projects, clients, or workflows. Once you've created a view you find useful, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters individually. This makes it easier to stay aligned on priorities and keeps everyone looking at the same version of the truth.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
